title: ToolCallEvalCase
description: A single evaluation case. Separates tool-selection ground truth from argument ground truth, and splits arguments into exact- vs semantic-scored fields.

expected_tool.description: Correct tool name. Null iff negative==true.

exact.description: Fields scored by exact match (enums, numbers, dates).

semantic.description: Free-text fields scored by similarity/judge, not exact match.

distractor_tools.description: Plausible-but-wrong tools present in the tool set for this case. Controls selection difficulty.

negative.description: If true, the correct behavior is to call NO tool. expected_tool must be null.

provenance.description: How this case was produced. Lets readers recompute metrics excluding any generation method.

source.description: For grounded cases: the public dataset the argument ground-truth is grounded in.
